name: Jab Step
idea: Stab one foot at your defender. If they back up, you have space to shoot.
why: A quick jab step looks like the start of a drive, so your defender backs up to stop it. That gives you room for a shot. If they don't back up, drive right past them instead, like in the Dribble Drive.
tryit: From the triple threat, keep one foot still and take a short, quick step with the other. Watch your defender: backed up? Shoot. Leaning? Go past.

frames.say: {1} has the ball in the *triple threat*, and {X1} is close.
*Jab step:* {1} keeps one foot still and stabs the other foot forward, like a drive. {X1} backs up!
{1} brings that foot right back. {X1} backed up, so now there's lots of space.
Bucket! Jab, look, then shoot when your defender backs up.
